title: Mind the instructions: a holistic evaluation of consistency and interactions in prompt-based learning

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing model accuracy on standard natural language understanding base datasets (e.g., MNLI, QQP, SQuAD) containing annotation artifacts against adversarial datasets (e.g., HANS, PAWS, SQuAD adversarial) to measure model reliance on shortcut heuristics.

Measuring the consistency and variance of model predictions across a large-scale grid search of in-context learning design choices, including variations in instruction templates, label balancing, calibration, and number of few-shot examples.
